summary: Debian's own Ansible can be old, so use the Ubuntu PPA with the matching codename (Trixie→noble, Bookworm→jammy, Bullseye→focal), adding its key to a dedicated keyring and a deb822 sources entry. apt-key add is deprecated.
questions: How do I install a recent Ansible on Debian 12?
Which Ubuntu codename should I use for the PPA on Debian?
Why shouldn't I use apt-key add for the Ansible PPA?

answer_card.title: Install a recent Ansible on Debian
answer_card.answer_md:
Codename map: Debian 13 → `noble`, 12 → `jammy`, 11 → `focal`.
```bash
UBUNTU_CODENAME='noble'
FINGERPRINT='6125E2A8C77F2818FB7BD15B93C4A3FD7BB9C367'
wget -O- "https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?fingerprint=on&op=get&search=0x${FINGERPRINT}" | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/ansible-archive-keyring.gpg
cat <<EOT | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ansible.sources > /dev/null
Types: deb
URIs: https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ansible/ansible/ubuntu/
Suites: ${UBUNTU_CODENAME}
Components: main
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/ansible-archive-keyring.gpg
EOT
sudo apt update && sudo apt install ansible
```
`apt-key add` is deprecated for security reasons.
